question.problem:
Let $X$ be the outcome of rolling an unfair six-sided die that follows the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. What is $\text{Var}[X]?$

| $x$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ |
question.worked_solution:
The variance of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{Var}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}(x-\text{E}[X])^{2}\cdot f(x).
$$

First, we need to compute $\text{E}[X].$ Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+4\cdot f(4)+5\cdot f(5)+6\cdot f(6) \\  & =1(\frac{1}{4})+2(\frac{1}{4})+3(\frac{1}{8})+4(\frac{1}{8})+5(\frac{1}{8})+6(\frac{1}{8}) \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting $\text{E}[X]=3$ into the variance formula, we get

$$
\text{Var}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}(x-3)^{2}\cdot f(x).
$$

Now, we compute the variance as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X] & =(1-3)^{2}\cdot f(1)+(2-3)^{2}\cdot f(2)+(3-3)^{2}\cdot f(3)+(4-3)^{2}\cdot f(4) \\  & +(5-3)^{2}\cdot f(5)+(6-3)^{2}\cdot f(6) \\  & =4\cdot f(1)+f(2)+0+f(4)+4\cdot f(5)+9\cdot f(6) \\  & =4(\frac{1}{4})+(\frac{1}{4})+0+(\frac{1}{8})+4(\frac{1}{8})+9(\frac{1}{8}) \\  & =3\end{aligned}
$$
